{{Top}}
'''Red Eleven''' was the callsign of the eleventh member of [[Red Squadron]]. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadrons with this name, and several beings went by the name Red Eleven.

[[Wenton Chan/Legends|Wenton Chan]] was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] pilot that flew with [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] as Red Eleven during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Chan was killed in the assault against the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], Red Eleven was unidentified, but his voice could be heard reporting in over the radio. Years later, ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' finally identified Wenton Chan, a pilot from the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], as Red Eleven.
